But high utilization means suppliers may face withdraw constraints (Burrow has liquidity utilization; at ~93% utilization, withdrawals still possible but interest rates spike).

Adding a new speculative collateral (Quantus Network quantum-secure encrypted money) with 60% LTV could introduce risk of bad debt if QTC crashes — borrowers could mint USDC against volatile QTC collateral. This is a forward-looking venue risk: listing volatile collateral increases bad-debt risk for USDC suppliers. But it's new; risk materializes over time. Worth noting as elevated factor.
